preconditions.description: K is the size of the permutation and is between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= p <= K for p in permutation)
preconditions.description: Each element in the permutation is between 1 and K inclusive.
The permutation is a list of K numbers.

preconditions.expression: all(len(exchange_matrix) == K for exchange_matrix in exchange_matrices)
preconditions.description: Each exchange matrix is a square matrix of size K.

preconditions.expression: all(all(e in {'Y', 'N'} for e in exchange_matrix) for exchange_matrix in exchange_matrices)
preconditions.description: Each element in the exchange matrix is either 'Y' or 'N'.

postconditions.description: The result is a permutation of K numbers.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= r <= K for r in result)
postconditions.description: Each number in the result is between 1 and K inclusive.
There are no duplicate numbers in the result.
The result is the lexicographically smallest permutation that can be obtained by exchanging elements according to the exchange matrices.
